objective: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.

description: A wonderful day has come, <name>. You've reached the age in which our priests/priestesses are trained in abilities only Night elves know. But it is not for me to train you. You must return to the Temple of the Moon and speak to Priestess Alathea as soon as your business here is concluded. She will test you to ensure you're prepared, and only then will she teach you Elune's Grace.
completion: By devoting yourself to Elune and our people, you have attained a state that not all of us can achieve. It is tradition that you then be taught even greater abilities for your devotion. Do you accept?
